preregs.falsifier: - **F1 (primary, truth table)** `full_not_above_tp` — BCa upper of the median paired difference ≤ 0. - **F2 (gate validity; guard `f2_nonlearning_pass`)** — a non-learning baseline (the phase-locked 3-cutter or the all-positive-trigram lexicon) passes every PASS clause on the computed pipeline. In dev: freeze is blocked (the computed-baseline test). In the sealed run: computed on the sealed streams; a FULL PASS is downgraded to WITHHELD. - **F3 (offset robustness; guard `f3_offset_robustness`)** — FULL's BCa lower bound of the median token F on the offset ≠ 0 seeds < 0.85: the segmentation claim is refuted as a phase-locked artifact. The harness records the run WITHHELD; the verdict review records the claim refuted. - **F4 (attribution; secondary; three-valued)** — v2 (live) vs v1 greedy capped (the sealed v1 learner) on the same archived streams: per-seed counts v2 > v1, = v1, < v1 and the exact two-sided sign-flip on the sum (zeros kept). **SHOWN** iff v2 > v1 at p ≤ 0.01; **WITHDRAWN** iff v2 < v1 at p ≤ 0.01 or v2 > v1 on no seed; **NOT SHOWN** otherwise. "v2 fixes v1's failure" may appear only when F4 is SHOWN. **N and power:** F4 is registered at the gate's N = 20, because the harness has no larger N for a secondary. Its power on the RED dev-pool resampling (400 resamples) is 73/400 at N = 20 (N = 30: 270/400; N = 40: 357/400; N = 50: 395/400), so NOT SHOWN is the expected outcome even if v2 improves on v1. A separate attribution registration at N = 40 would be needed to test the claim with useful power; it is not part of this gate. (v2 vs v1 uncapped and v2 vs v2 capped at 4 are reported beside F4, descriptively.) - **F5 (consistency check; not a falsifier)** — the per-seed v2 lexicon size on a unigram-preserving shuffle of the same heard stream, reported against the real lexicon size. It was first registered as a falsifier ("median ≤ 4 refutes the word-level claim"), but that criterion cannot fire: a shuffled 300-syllable stream always keeps recurring trigrams, so its lexicon is never smaller than the real 4 words. It is kept only as a consistency check. - **F9 (phase choice; secondary)** — v2 (live) vs the TP-phase 3-cutter and vs the fewest-distinct-tokens phase selector on the same streams: per-seed counts and the exact sign-flip p. It measures how much v2 adds beyond the supplied length prior plus a phase choice; on dev it adds nothing (Metrics; live in pilot 3: v2 better on 0, equal on 13, worse on 7, p 0.015625, against each learner). - **F6 (additivity)** — the default `:greedy` fingerprint (`tools/experiments/chunk_v2/default_fingerprint.exs`, `0511006a…b5a12b`; CHUNK-V2-05) changes: additivity refuted. - **F7 (truth independence)** — the lexicon depends on anything beyond the stream, `l_max` and `min_count` (the lab options are exactly those three; the live node uses the organ defaults; tests): truth independence refuted. - **F8 (carrier parity; guard `f8_carrier_parity`)** — on any seed the live report is missing, did not hear the whole stream (`n_heard` ≠ 300), or its lexicon differs from lab-side `Chunk.reestimate/2` on the archived heard stream, or its segmentation differs from `Chunk.segment(heard, live lexicon)`: the carrier claim is refuted (WITHHELD).

preregs.hypothesis: After a delay, the declared lab agent `Ddna.Lab.HumanTests.ANotBX.NativeAgent` (a native discrete node) reaches the well where a hidden object is. It integrates hiding cues of stated clarity, how many there are and their order, with a hiding prior it learns from feedback. On a weak frame that names the side found less often, it reaches to the side found more often more often when this session's finds have been more lopsided, and follows the frame when they have not. It uses the strength of its learned hiding prior (its Dirichlet estimate of the hiding bias), not only its side. C8 gates this against the exact bound B* of class B: every policy that reads the session only through which side was found more often, the side of the last find and the trial index. It carries the same fixed model to an unseen family (`conflict`, C7) without re-fit. Secondary, not gated: it stays within counts of the analytic Bayes-optimal observer for the same generative process.
